mutations.description: Erroneously divide the angular gyrofrequency by 2 pi inside the angular-frequency function.

transformation.original: function electronGyroAngular(BTesla) { return E * positive('B', BTesla) / ME; }
transformation.replacement: function electronGyroAngular(BTesla) { return E * positive('B', BTesla) / (ME * TWO_PI); }

mutations.rationale: The accepted independent electron gyrofrequency anchor directly constrains the angular-to-cyclic-frequency convention.

mutations.description: Replace the square-root density dependence with an erroneous linear density dependence.

transformation.original: return Math.sqrt(positive('n_e', nePerM3) * E * E / (EPS0 * ME));
transformation.replacement: return positive('n_e', nePerM3) * Math.sqrt(E * E / (EPS0 * ME));

mutations.rationale: The frozen independent coefficient fixes the value at 1 cm^-3 and cannot inherit this mutated density dependence.

mutations.description: Use electron mass instead of ion mass in the ion plasma-frequency denominator.

transformation.original: return Math.sqrt(positive('n_i', niPerM3) * z * z * E * E / (EPS0 * ionMass(mu)));
transformation.replacement: return Math.sqrt(positive('n_i', niPerM3) * z * z * E * E / (EPS0 * ME));

mutations.rationale: The independent proton anchor fixes the species-mass dependence for Z = 1 and mu = 1.

mutations.description: Move density from the denominator to the numerator, reversing the shielding-length density dependence.

transformation.original: return Math.sqrt(EPS0 * evToJoules(temperatureEv) / (positive('n_e', nePerM3) * E * E));
transformation.replacement: return Math.sqrt(EPS0 * evToJoules(temperatureEv) * positive('n_e', nePerM3) / (E * E));

mutations.rationale: The independent Debye-length anchor constrains the value at the frozen 1 eV, 1 cm^-3 state.

mutations.description: Multiply by electron plasma angular frequency instead of dividing by it.
mutations.rationale: The independent inertial-length anchor directly constrains d_e = c/omega_pe.

mutations.description: Multiply by ion plasma angular frequency instead of dividing by it.

transformation.original: function ionInertialLength(niPerM3, Z = 1, mu = 1) { return C / ionPlasmaAngular(niPerM3, Z, mu); }
transformation.replacement: function ionInertialLength(niPerM3, Z = 1, mu = 1) { return C * ionPlasmaAngular(niPerM3, Z, mu); }

mutations.rationale: The independent proton inertial-length anchor directly constrains d_i = c/omega_pi.

mutations.description: Use the reciprocal conversion direction, k_B/e, in the eV-to-kelvin function.

transformation.original: function evToKelvin(temperatureEv) { return positive('temperature', temperatureEv) * EV / KB; }
transformation.replacement: function evToKelvin(temperatureEv) { return positive('temperature', temperatureEv) * KB / EV; }

mutations.rationale: The independently anchored SI conversion is exact at the defining-constant level and directly constrains this direction.

mutations.description: Remove the 2 pi factor from k = 2 pi f/V while leaving the inverse mapping unchanged.

transformation.original: return TWO_PI * positive('frequency', frequencyHz) / positive('flow speed', flowSpeedMps);
transformation.replacement: return positive('frequency', frequencyHz) / positive('flow speed', flowSpeedMps);

mutations.rationale: The paired Taylor mapping round trip is a genuine inverse-property check for a defect isolated to the wavenumber direction.

mutations.description: Change B^2/(2 mu_0) to B^2/mu_0, producing a factor-two pressure error and halving beta.
mutations.rationale: Current beta checks are implementation identities or scaling tests; neither independently fixes the normalization factor.

mutations.scientificQuantity: ion sound speed and ion-sound gyroradius
mutations.description: Remove the ion charge-state Z dependence from the ion sound speed.

transformation.original: return Math.sqrt(positive('gamma', gamma) * chargeState(Z) * evToJoules(temperatureEv) / ionMass(mu));

mutations.rationale: No accepted independent anchor or present property test varies Z for this quantity.

mutations.description: Swap the pressure numerator and inertia denominator in the reduced dispersive factor.
mutations.rationale: The current MHD-limit identity evaluates at k_perp = 0, where both forms coincide; the model remains scientifically quarantined.
Parallel/perpendicular and collision-frequency conventions remain under source-level review, with no accepted independent resistivity anchor.

return Math.abs(finite('k_parallel', kParallelPerM) * finite('k_perp', kPerpendicularPerM)) *

mutations.rationale: The approved SD-10 source equation is R=|k_parallel k_perpendicular| rho_s^2; the independent fixed-value analytical identity must kill reintroduction of the unsupported Padé denominator.
